exceptions.customer_experience: Recipient gets email/text with enrollment steps and daily reminders after 5 days; sender sees item under Activity > Pending and can 'Stop payment' until enrollment; expires after 14 days with funds returned.
exceptions.bank_handling: Bank holds funds until recipient enrolls or 14 days elapse
exceptions.resolution: Payment 'automatically cancelled' and funds returned after 14 days

exceptions.trigger: Sender wants to cancel a payment
exceptions.customer_experience: Zelle® > 'Activity' > Pending tab > 'Cancel' (future-dated/recurring; choose next payment or whole plan) or 'Stop payment' -> confirm -> "You've canceled this payment" / "You've stopped this payment". Payments already deposited cannot be canceled; payments to unenrolled recipients can be cancelled until they enroll.
exceptions.bank_handling: Payments to enrolled users 'may not be canceled or revoked' once processing begins
Bank makes 'a reasonable effort' to recover funds; no guarantee

exceptions.customer_experience: Report within 60 days of statement; call immediately
exceptions.bank_handling: Zelle-specific liability rule (Section 3.17): no liability if reported within 60 days; Section 1.16 tiers do not apply; Reg E error-resolution with provisional credit within 10 business days
exceptions.resolution: Reimbursement for unauthorized transactions; transactions by anyone customer gave credentials to are treated as authorized

exceptions.customer_experience: Sender has already acknowledged the static Security Reminder; no in-app or Help Center scam-claim path (KB returns no scam answer); customer calls 1-888-751-9000.
exceptions.bank_handling: Terms: 'ZELLE® DOES NOT OFFER A PROTECTION PROGRAM FOR AUTHORIZED PAYMENTS'; business page: 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement' (network policy since Nov 2023); 2022 class action alleged claim opened then denied
exceptions.resolution: Case-by-case; imposter scams may be reimbursed, purchase scams not

exceptions.customer_experience: Transfer 'may take longer' for identity checks, fraud prevention or regulatory reasons
exceptions.bank_handling: Risk review; also, if sender's instant limits are exceeded the payment is routed 'Next Day' or 'Three Day ACH'; account-number recipients always 1-3 business days.

exceptions.trigger: Recipient blocked by risk screening or token cannot be added
exceptions.customer_experience: Add-contact error: 'There's a problem. For your protection, we cannot send money to this recipient.' or 'You can't add this mobile number to your contact. Call 888-388-0406 to resolve the issue.'
exceptions.bank_handling: Pre-send recipient risk screening blocks the contact
exceptions.resolution: Ask recipient for a different email/mobile or to send a request; call 888-388-0406

exceptions.customer_experience: Payment cannot go within minutes; delivered 'Next Day' or 'Three Day ACH'
exceptions.bank_handling: Automatic downgrade to ACH delivery; limits cannot be temporarily or permanently changed

assessment: Simple four-step flow with contact sync and Zelle Tags; English-only restriction and absence of any published scam interstitial, in-app scam reporting or name-match preview are notable gaps versus top-4 peers. Instant limits raised in 2026 to align with peers.

terms.limits: Instant: $2,500/day, $10,000/month (consumer); SMB $3,000/day, $15,000/month; Private Client $5,000/$30,000; inbound requests up to $100,000
terms.fees: Free (within minutes and standard ACH delivery)
terms.cutoffs: Zelle credits available within minutes; 11 p.m. ET listed cutoff for same-day posting
